description: Defines the DataObjects_Variables class for managing 'variables' table in the Revive Adserver project, including properties, methods for audit, context, account ownership, and setting variable code based on tracker method.

classes.name: DataObjects_Variables
classes.description: Represents the 'variables' table with properties for each column, methods for audit, context, account ownership, and setting variable code based on tracker method.

methods.name: staticGet
methods.description: Static method to retrieve a record based on key and value.

methods.name: _auditEnabled
methods.description: Returns true indicating auditing is enabled for this object.

methods.name: _getContextId
methods.description: Returns the context ID, which is the variable's ID.

methods.name: getOwningAccountIds
methods.description: Returns account IDs owning audit trail entries, based on tracker ID.

methods.name: _buildAuditArray
methods.description: Builds an audit array with the variable's name as description.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the variable code based on the tracker variable method, using match expression.
